c2_bad.why: A player track-chooser sheet promoted to core on the lexical match of 'selected'; the task is focus visibility on catalogue rails, and the app's TrackPickerSheet is not the screen in scope.
Repeat of the c1 miss: details/resume/watchlist guidance selected on the words 'row' and 'selected'; says nothing about how a focused row should read at 3 m.

Hold-repeat pacing is the p5-09 defect; here it is the sole carrier of interaction.focus_visible and a11y.reduced_motion, so the critical concept is again attached to a record that does not state the focus-contrast rule.
Polite live regions and toast duration have nothing to do with a visual focus-state contrast defect.
Repeat of the c1 miss: a web record (aria-rowcount, windowed rendering) selected for the 'performance' concern on a tvOS SwiftUI screen whose LazyHStack already virtualises.

c2_direction_unjustified.why: nav-tv-side again: the app's shell is a top TabView (Watch/Search), not a side drawer, so the preserved slot text describes navigation the codebase does not have.

why: Requirements got better (mode accessibility+audit, status CONFIDENT with no spurious platform-confirm, problem_domain includes accessibility) and a11y.contrast / tv.dark_first / a11y.reduced_motion are now actually delivered via tv-dark-first, but the bundle lost the two records c1 actually used (tv-safe-area for the lift/overscan budget, color-states-complete for 'selected != focused'), added a spurious core sheet record, kept media-resume-and-details and web-virtualize-long-lists, and still has no record stating focus-indicator contrast at distance or a row-level focus cue.
